## Introduction

Building on v8, this script smooths the Gaussian increment model across neighboring ranks. Namely, instead of treating rank 1, rank 2, rank 3, etc. as fully separate processes, we replace the per-rank mean and variance of weekly log-share changes with a *moving-average estimate over a local rank neighborhood* (defined and tunable as a new parameter in the sim, `h`).

This is the first step attempting to reduce noise. That is the goal here is to make the mean and variance in rank space smoother, reduce high-frequency rank-to-rank movement, and (hopefully) make it easier to see and eventually fit the global patterns that drive CDC shape and durable change.

So, building on the setup from v8, we update here accordingly:

  - We still compute one-week log-share changes `d_log_w` by rank from the empirical data

  - Estimate per-rank step "moments": $\bar d_r = \mathbb{E}[d\log w_r]$ and $s_r = \mathrm{sd}(d\log w_r)$

  - Then we smooth these moments across ranks using a moving window of size $2h+1$ centered at each rank $r$:
    - $\tilde d_r = \mathrm{MA}_h(\bar d)_r$
    - $\tilde s_r = \mathrm{MA}_h(s)_r$

  - The sim then draws increments using:
  
$$
\Delta\log w_r \sim \mathcal{N}\bigl(\mu + \tilde d_r,\; (\sigma\,\tilde s_r)^2\bigr)
$$

  where:
  
  - $\mu$ is a global drift parameter capturing the shifts of all ranks' increments (up/down)
  - $\sigma$ is a global volatility parameter
  - $h$ is the smoothing half-width (i.e., how many ranks above/below to average over)

In addition to the update to account for the moving average to smooth things out, the next key update in this v9 report is likelwise updating the grid search to include $h$ as a third parameter.

## Setup

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(broom)

set.seed(1823)

raw <- read_parquet(
  here::here("/Users/philipwaggoner/Dropbox (Personal)/GW - IDDP/Projects/Rank Diffusion (Matt)/Facebook/fb_ranked_weekly.parquet")
)
```


```{r}
endpoint_weekly <- raw %>%
  transmute(
    week = date,
    endpoint_id,
    metric_value,
    rank = rank
  ) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  arrange(desc(metric_value), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    rank  = row_number(),
    share = metric_value / sum(metric_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

max_rank_by_week <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(max_rank = max(rank), .groups = "drop")

max_rank_seen <- max(max_rank_by_week$max_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# baseline CDC curve (mean share by rank)
mean_share <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(w_bar = mean(share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(rank)

# rank-wise weekly delta log(share) pools
rank_panel <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  arrange(week, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    share = pmax(share, 1e-12),
    log_w = log(share),
    dlogw = log_w - lag(log_w)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.finite(dlogw))
```


```{r}
K_cut   <- min(12000L, max_rank_seen)
K_max   <- min(K_cut + 2000L, max_rank_seen)
T_weeks <- 52
N_paths <- 120

# seed curve w0 up to K_max
w0_raw <- mean_share$w_bar[seq_len(min(K_max, nrow(mean_share)))]
w0_raw <- w0_raw / sum(w0_raw)

buffer_tail <- 2000L

entrant_pool <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  filter(rank > K_cut,
         rank <= min(K_cut + buffer_tail, max_rank_seen)) %>%
  transmute(share) %>%
  filter(is.finite(share), share > 0)

stopifnot(nrow(entrant_pool) > 100)

entrant_sampler <- function(n) {
  sample(entrant_pool$share, size = n, replace = TRUE)
}
```

## Moving-average smoothing helper over ranks

Here's where updates start. We smooth a rank-indexed vector using a centered window of half-width `h` (so window size is `2h+1`).

```{r}
moving_average_rank <- function(x, h) {
  stopifnot(h >= 0L)
  n <- length(x)
  if (h == 0L) return(x)

  cs <- c(0, cumsum(replace_na(x, 0)))
  out <- numeric(n)

  for (r in seq_len(n)) {
    lo <- max(1L, r - h)
    hi <- min(n, r + h)
    out[r] <- (cs[hi + 1L] - cs[lo]) / (hi - lo + 1L)
  }
  out
}
```

Now, these steps: 

  1. compute *raw* per-rank mean and sd of `d_log_w`
  
  2. for a given smoothing half-width `h`, compute *smoothed* per-rank mean and sd vectors

```{r}
# raw (unsmoothed) Gaussian params by rank
gauss_params_raw <- rank_panel %>%
  filter(rank <= K_max) %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dlogw = mean(dlogw, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dlogw   = sd(dlogw,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(tibble(rank = 1:K_max), by = "rank") %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_dlogw = replace_na(mean_dlogw, 0),
    sd_dlogw   = replace_na(sd_dlogw,   0),
    sd_dlogw   = if_else(sd_dlogw <= 0 | !is.finite(sd_dlogw), 1e-6, sd_dlogw)
  )

# build smoothed parameters for a chosen smoothing half-width h
build_gaussian_params_smoothed <- function(h) {
  m <- gauss_params_raw$mean_dlogw
  s <- gauss_params_raw$sd_dlogw

  tibble(
    rank = 1:K_max,
    mean_dlogw_s = moving_average_rank(m, h = h),
    sd_dlogw_s   = pmax(moving_average_rank(s, h = h), 1e-6)
  )
}
```

## Empirical CDC and durable-change

```{r}
# Empirical CDC (top-K_cut, normalized within top-K)
emp_cdc <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  arrange(desc(share), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank_in_week = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rank_in_week <= K_cut) %>%
  mutate(shareK = share / sum(share)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(rank = rank_in_week) %>%
  summarise(w_bar = mean(shareK, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rank_bucket <- function(r) {
  case_when(
    r <= 25   ~ "large",
    r <= 250  ~ "midsize",
    TRUE      ~ "small"
  )
}

emp_durable <- endpoint_weekly %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  arrange(week, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    log_w = log(pmax(share, 1e-12)),
    log_w_lead4 = lead(log_w, 4),
    log_w_lead8 = lead(log_w, 8),
    d4 = log_w_lead4 - log_w,
    d8 = log_w_lead8 - log_w
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(bucket = rank_bucket(rank)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(d4) | !is.na(d8))

emp_durable_long <- emp_durable %>%
  select(bucket, d4, d8) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(d4, d8),
               names_to = "horizon",
               values_to = "d") %>%
  mutate(horizon = if_else(horizon == "d4", 4L, 8L)) %>%
  group_by(bucket, horizon) %>%
  summarise(med_abs_emp = median(abs(d), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Sim: Gaussian increments with smoothed moments / moving average

This simulator is the same as v8, except it takes the *smoothed per-rank mean and sd vectors* as input.

```{r}
simulate_rank_paths <- function(
  w0, K_cut, K_max, T = 52, n_paths = 200,
  mu = 0, sigma = 1, entry_frac = 0.10,
  mean_vec, sd_vec
) {
  stopifnot(length(mean_vec) == K_max, length(sd_vec) == K_max)

  top_n_sorted <- function(w, n) w[order(w, decreasing = TRUE)][seq_len(n)]

  # sample one Gaussian increment per rank
  sample_increments_gaussian <- function(mu = 0, sigma = 1) {
    rnorm(K_max, mean = mu + mean_vec, sd = sigma * sd_vec)
  }

  snapshots <- vector("list", n_paths)
  growth_collect <- list(h4 = NULL, h8 = NULL)
  horizons <- c(4L, 8L)

  for (p in seq_len(n_paths)) {
    # initialize universe to K_max
    if (length(w0) < K_max) {
      w <- c(w0, entrant_sampler(K_max - length(w0)))
      w <- w / sum(w)
    } else {
      w <- w0[1:K_max]; w <- w / sum(w)
    }

    # baseline top-K for durable change
    w_base <- top_n_sorted(w, K_cut)
    w_base <- w_base / sum(w_base)

    snaps_p <- vector("list", T)

    for (t in seq_len(T)) {
      dlogw <- sample_increments_gaussian(mu = mu, sigma = sigma)

      w <- w * exp(dlogw)
      w <- pmax(w, 1e-18)
      w <- w / sum(w)

      # exit & entry: keep top-K_cut, refill to K_max
      w_top  <- top_n_sorted(w, K_cut)
      n_tail <- K_max - K_cut
      if (n_tail > 0) {
        n_add <- max(1L, floor(n_tail * entry_frac))
        w <- c(w_top, entrant_sampler(n_add), entrant_sampler(n_tail - n_add))
      } else {
        w <- w_top
      }
      w <- w / sum(w)

      # CDC snapshot at time t (top-K, renormalized)
      wK <- top_n_sorted(w, K_cut)
      wK <- wK / sum(wK)
      snaps_p[[t]] <- tibble(path = p, t = t, rank = seq_len(K_cut), share = wK)

      # durable change at 4w and 8w relative to baseline
      if (t %in% horizons) {
        lg  <- log(wK / w_base)
        lbl <- paste0("h", t)
        growth_collect[[lbl]] <- rbind(
          growth_collect[[lbl]],
          cbind(path = p, rank = seq_len(K_cut),
                horizon = t, log_growth = lg)
        )
      }
    }

    snapshots[[p]] <- bind_rows(snaps_p)
  }

  growth_df <- bind_rows(
    as_tibble(growth_collect$h4),
    as_tibble(growth_collect$h8)
  )

  list(
    snapshots = bind_rows(snapshots),
    growth    = growth_df
  )
}

# extend w0 to K_max once
if (length(w0_raw) < K_max) {
  w0_ext <- c(w0_raw, entrant_sampler(K_max - length(w0_raw)))
  w0_ext <- w0_ext / sum(w0_ext)
} else {
  w0_ext <- w0_raw[1:K_max]; w0_ext <- w0_ext / sum(w0_ext)
}

# metrics
cdc_rmse <- function(emp, sim) {
  df <- emp %>%
    inner_join(sim, by = "rank", suffix = c("_emp", "_sim"))
  sqrt(mean((log(df$w_bar_emp) - log(df$w_bar_sim))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

durable_rmse <- function(emp_long, sim_long) {
  df <- emp_long %>%
    inner_join(sim_long, by = c("bucket", "horizon"),
               suffix = c("_emp", "_sim"))
  sqrt(mean((df$med_abs_emp - df$med_abs_sim)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

## Grid search over (mu, sigma, h)

We now grid over:

- `mu`: global drift
- `sigma`: global volatility scaling
- `h`: smoothing half-width over ranks (again, window size = `2h+1`)

Interpretation of `h`:

- `h = 0`: no smoothing (this reduces to v8 Gaussian moments, with each rank, r, in isolation)
- `h = 5`: $\pm$ $h$ ranks, e.g., if `h = 5`, we get a window size of 11
- thus, a larger `h` results in more aggressive smoothing, and less rank-to-rank noise

```{r eval = FALSE}
mu_grid     <- c(-0.01, -0.005, 0.0, 0.005)
sigma_grid  <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0)
h_grid      <- c(0L, 2L, 5L)

lambda_cdc <- 0.7

param_grid <- expand_grid(mu = mu_grid, sigma = sigma_grid, h = h_grid)

grid_results <- vector("list", nrow(param_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(param_grid))) {
  mu_i    <- param_grid$mu[i]
  sigma_i <- param_grid$sigma[i]
  h_i     <- param_grid$h[i]

  message("running sim for mu=", mu_i, ", sigma=", sigma_i, ", h=", h_i)

  # build smoothed mean/sd vectors for this h
  sm <- build_gaussian_params_smoothed(h = h_i)
  mean_vec <- sm$mean_dlogw_s
  sd_vec   <- sm$sd_dlogw_s

  set.seed(500 + i)

  sim_i <- simulate_rank_paths(
    w0 = w0_ext, K_cut = K_cut, K_max = K_max,
    T = T_weeks, n_paths = N_paths,
    mu = mu_i, sigma = sigma_i, entry_frac = 0.10,
    mean_vec = mean_vec, sd_vec = sd_vec
  )

  # CDC for current sim
  sim_cdc_i <- sim_i$snapshots %>%
    group_by(rank) %>%
    summarise(w_bar = mean(share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # durable-change for current sim (median abs log growth by bucket and horizon)
  sim_durable_long <- sim_i$growth %>%
    mutate(bucket = rank_bucket(rank)) %>%
    group_by(bucket, horizon) %>%
    summarise(med_abs_sim = median(abs(log_growth), na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")

  rmse_cdc_i <- cdc_rmse(emp_cdc, sim_cdc_i)
  rmse_dur_i <- durable_rmse(emp_durable_long, sim_durable_long)

  score_i <- lambda_cdc * rmse_cdc_i + (1 - lambda_cdc) * rmse_dur_i

  grid_results[[i]] <- list(
    mu       = mu_i,
    sigma    = sigma_i,
    h        = h_i,
    cdc      = sim_cdc_i,
    rmse_cdc = rmse_cdc_i,
    rmse_dur = rmse_dur_i,
    score    = score_i
  )
}

metrics_tbl <- map_dfr(grid_results, ~ tibble(
  mu       = .x$mu,
  sigma    = .x$sigma,
  h        = .x$h,
  rmse_cdc = .x$rmse_cdc,
  rmse_dur = .x$rmse_dur,
  score    = .x$score
)) %>%
  arrange(score)

write_rds(grid_results, "grid_results_v9.rds")
write_rds(metrics_tbl,   "metrics_tbl_v9.rds")
```

## CDC grid results (empirical vs simulated)

Note: cols are labeled with both `sigma` and `h` making it straightforward to see how smoothing impacts the fit.

```{r}
grid_results <- read_rds("grid_results_v9.rds")
metrics_tbl  <- read_rds("metrics_tbl_v9.rds")

grid_cdc_plot_df <- map_dfr(grid_results, function(res) {
  bind_rows(
    emp_cdc %>% mutate(source = "Empirical"),
    res$cdc  %>% mutate(source = "Simulated")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      mu = res$mu,
      sigma_h = paste0("sigma=", res$sigma, ", h=", res$h)
    )
})

facet_labs <- labeller(
  mu = function(x) paste0("mu = ", x),
  sigma_h = function(x) x
)
```

```{r eval = FALSE}
ggplot(grid_cdc_plot_df, aes(rank, w_bar, linetype = source)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  facet_grid(mu ~ sigma_h, labeller = facet_labs) +
  labs(
    title = "CDC grid search (rank smoothing): Empirical vs Simulated",
    x = "Rank (log)",
    y = "Mean share (log)",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
